leads.name: Cabbage Palm (Cordyline australis), California state champion
leads.reason: California Registry of Big Trees (Cal Poly UFEI, selectree.calpoly.edu/api/bigtrees/getAllBt), read 2026-09-27. FINDING AID ONLY: the licence is unstated, so this register is never the cited source; a verify pass must find the tree in an independent source (park, garden, city, press) before it can ship. Units as published: circumference in INCHES, height in FEET. State champion, 149.75 points; 16.5 km from the city centre. Needs: an independent source, public access (hard rule 10), and a pin checked on aerial imagery.
